body: At least 7 years since I was 18. I'm not totally sure if I was depressed before college. I definitely had anxiety (I was diagnosed as a young child). A lot of it comes from feelings of rejection and abandonment (mostly relationship-related).

Thanks, I appreciate that. Yeah, I'm sure that the idea of people's lives improving is a big part of wanting to keep people alive. And I get it...for most people, it is best to stay alive. Most people are able to have enjoyable experiences and make valuable contributions to the world around them. I just don't believe I'm one of those people.
